question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1

WITH pct_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    month,
    NULLIF(average_attendance, 0) AS avg_attendance,
    NULLIF(enrolment, 0) AS enrolment,
    (average_attendance * 100.0) / enrolment AS attendance_pct
  FROM attendance_2024
),
pct_2024 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    month,
    NULLIF(average_attendance, 0) AS avg_attendance,
    NULLIF(enrolment, 0) AS enrolment,
    (average_attendance * 100.0) / enrolment AS attendance_pct
  FROM attendance_2023
)
SELECT
  centre_name,
  month,
  attendance_pct_2023,
  attendance_pct_2024,
  (attendance_pct_2024 - attendance_pct_2023) AS pct_point_change
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(p23.centre_name, p24.centre_name) AS centre_name,
    COALESCE(p23.month, p24.month) AS month,
    p23.attendance_pct AS attendance_pct_2023,
    p24.attendance_pct AS attendance_pct_2024
  FROM pct_2023 p23
  FULL OUTER JOIN pct_2024 p24
    ON p23.centre_name = p24.centre_name
   AND p23.month = p24.month
) t
WHERE attendance_pct_2023 IS NOT NULL
  AND attendance_pct_2024 IS NOT NULL
  AND (attendance_pct_2024 - attendance_pct_2023) < 0
ORDER BY (attendance_pct_2024 - attendance_pct_2023) ASC
LIMIT 1;
